title: R25-T030: Strengthen the tests of ps (pscheck.py)
body:
## What I did
- Documented the contract, preconditions, and protected condition of `ps()` in `pscheck.py` citing specific source lines:
  - Line 41: `program = input(...)`
  - Line 45: `output = commands.getoutput(...)`
  - Line 46: `proginfo = string.split(output)`
  - Lines 49-65: stdout format and positional mappings (Owner=0, PID=1, PPID=2, Time=4, Path=5)
  - Line 66: `except:` failure boundary
- Added minimal Python 2/3 compatibility imports (`subprocess as commands`, `string.split = str.split`) without altering supported behavior or public interface.
- Kept deliberate mutants OUT of final `pscheck.py`.

- Testing with smallest valid and ordinary fixtures establishes exact behavioral baselines before mutating code.
- Named assertion `assert_owner_field` reliably passes on authentic output (`proginfo[0]`) and fails with an explanatory semantic assertion error when a mutant accesses `proginfo[1]` (PID) for the Owner field.

title: R25-T023: Cross-check date timeserver (date-timeserver.py)
